goal: Attempt records carry rolled-up token, iteration, turn, and last-activity aggregates updated at iteration boundaries, and the dashboard snapshot is computed from relational rows with no telemetry-event scan.

constraints: Spec FR-6 is authoritative: cumulative input/output/cache tokens, iterations completed, turns, last-activity timestamp on the attempt row, updated through the existing optimistic-concurrency write path at iteration boundaries
Snapshot values (tokens, cost, idle, age, iteration position) must match today's telemetry-derived values for a driven run, within timer tolerance
Update BOTH schema files (sqlite and the postgres mirror), bump CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, and refuse pre-feature databases via the existing StoreSchemaError path -- no forward migration
Attempt is a pure dataclass in lifecycle.py: add fields without introducing I/O imports; the purity tests must pass unweakened
Enumerate and update every test that pins the old schema version constant or the Attempt shape in the same commit (search for CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION and Attempt( across all packages' tests)
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: Do not stop writing telemetry events to the store yet -- the write-path move is the next task
Do not touch sdk_messages or run_sequence
edge_cases: A run with zero completed iterations must produce zeroed aggregates, not NULL-driven crashes in the snapshot
Replay of domain events must not be affected by the new columns
